description: For each request, select up to two installed skills and one agent profile. Your model, tools and permissions stay the same.
noSkills: No skills available for manual selection.
roleLimit: An agent profile adds instructions to the current model. It does not start a separate agent. Scripts and external programs are not run by skill selection.
adapted: Spanish adaptation of the original source

errors.preference: The automatic selection preference could not be read or saved. The last confirmed setting is retained.
errors.discovery: Installed skills or agent profiles could not be read. No automatic instructions were added.
errors.read: A selected instruction file could not be read. The chat continues without automatic instructions.
errors.limit: The selected instructions exceed 12,000 characters. Nothing was truncated or added; choose a skill manually if needed.
errors.missing: The matching resource is not available for model invocation. No automatic instructions were added.
